extracted.name: Asparagus with Sliced Almonds and Parmesan Cheese
extracted.description: Asparagus spears are sauteed in butter with sliced almonds and parmesan cheese. This is a terrific side with grilled salmon or turkey meatballs.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add asparagus; cook and stir about 3 minutes. Stir in almonds and Parmesan; cook until cheese slightly browned, about 3 to 5 minutes.
